Big 4 Bank Docklands, Melbourne | $43.33 PH Plus Super | Call Centre | 31 August 2026 | PR & CIT ONLY!   
 What's on Offer? 
 Multiple intakes for this recruit, with different rosters! 
 
 31st August Start Date: Tuesday-Saturday 
 14th September Start Date Thursday-Sunday 
 28th September: Monday-Friday 
 
 $43.33 Per Hour Plus Super 
 
 
 Temporary assignment with strong potential for permanency 
 
 
 5 weeks of paid training 
 
 
 Hybrid working available after training and proficiency 
 
 
 Location: Docklands, Melbourne 
 
 
 Launch your banking career with one of Australia's leading financial institutions. 
 Are you someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys helping customers and is motivated by achieving results? This is an exciting opportunity to join a Big 4 Bank and be part of one of Australia's largest banking migration programmes, supporting customers through the integration. 
   
 With customer demand continuing to grow, we are looking for customer-focused individuals who are eager to develop their careers in financial services. Multiple intakes are planned across September, providing several opportunities to join this high-profile project. 
   Your new company     
 This opportunity sits within one of Australia's most significant banking transformation projects. As customers transition across to another bank, the demand for exceptional customer support continues to grow. 
 You'll join a supportive team environment where you'll receive extensive training, ongoing coaching and the opportunity to build valuable experience within a Big 4 Bank. Whether your background is in retail, hospitality, fast food, reception, customer service or contact centres, this role offers a fantastic pathway into banking and financial services. 
   Your new role     
 You'll be one of the first points of contact for customers calling with banking and migration-related enquiries. 
   
 Working within a high-volume contact centre environment, you'll assist customers with: 
 
 Internet banking support 
 Everyday banking and account enquiries 
 Lending-related enquiries 
 Account maintenance requests 
 Balances and general banking support 
 Migration questions 
 
 This role can involve handling up to 100 inbound calls per day, making it ideal for individuals who enjoy a busy environment and are confident managing multiple tasks while delivering exceptional customer experiences. 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Strong communication and customer service skills 
 Must be a Permanent Resident or Australian Citizen 
 Resilience and the ability to perform in a fast-paced environment 
 A positive, customer-first mindset 
 Strong computer and multitasking skills 
 The ability to learn quickly and adapt to new systems 
 Professionalism when managing challenging customer conversations 
 A reliable and team-oriented approach 
 
   
 Ideal for candidates from hospitality, retail, fast food, reception, customer service, administration, contact centres or banking who are looking to build a long-term career in financial services. 
   What you'll get in return     
 
 Comprehensive onboarding and ongoing support 
 Buddying and call-listening programmes 
 Progressive transition onto live customer calls 
 Hybrid working model (3 days office / 2 days home) following training 
 Strong temp-to-perm opportunities for high performers 
 Valuable experience with a Big 4 Bank 
 Supportive leaders and genuine career development pathways 
 
   What you need to do now     
 If you're looking to take the next step in your career and gain valuable experience with a Big 4 Bank, we'd love to hear from you. Send your up-to-date CV to howard.richards@hays.com.au  Please  click here  to apply.
